intents: Which creators are worth paying, at what price — and what should they make?
Find real UGC creators to film for our ads
Who should we seed product to?
What should I pay this creator?
Write a brief and a first message for this creator
Find LinkedIn, YouTube, newsletter or podcast creators for our B2B product
reads: Brand Brain when brain_* tools are listed: brain_map first (core rules, never-list, waiting items, products, audience, rivals, 14, 22, 23), brain_search for creators in talks and past deals; fallback brand_read + knowledge_search
claims: sign-off and 'Claims you may use' / dont / must facts via claims-gate (written by its scoped sign-off, or earlier by learn-my-brand, unreleased)

brand brain: products with price, brand kit and voice, learnings (GooseWorks brand research and the app; learn-my-brand, unreleased); gift unit cost and who approves spend are usually not on file — asked of the human
brand brain: the brand's and competitors' recent organic posts and the competitor set (research-competitors / server)
Inspiration library: saved outlier posts and the creators behind them (research-market)
persona — who a creator's followers must match (research-market)
campaign record: a campaign brief that calls for a creator leg (plan-campaign)
workspace creators/roster.csv via outcomes-ledger, earlier wave-1.md and briefs (this playbook); research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md (spend-gate)
human: goal, budget, creators in talks, target CAC / CPA / planned media, cost per demo or install, roster status and wave results
run records runs/work-with-creators/creator-programme/wave-<n>/… (run-memory) and the roster for wave results
writes: workspace creators/roster.csv (living roster in the outcomes-ledger schema: status, suppression, wave, wave result, quoted rate) — read by the human and every later run; analyze-performance reads it for roster seeding (creators are a future row there); plan-campaign when a creator leg is Run/Test

workspace creators/<date>/report.md (→ 'Creator report — <Brand> — <date>', keep-history), wave-1.md, near-misses.csv, briefs/<handle>.md (brief + first-message drafts) — read by the founder, who sends and negotiates; wave-1.md read back on the next run
workspace creators/roster-summary.md → brand document 'Creator roster — <Brand> — <date>' (supersede; no contact details) — read by later runs and plan-campaign
workspace creators/lessons/<date>.md → brand document 'Creator lessons — <Brand> — <date>' (keep-history; numbers only) via outcomes-ledger — read by later runs
research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md rows — read by every playbook's spend estimates
run records runs/work-with-creators/creator-programme/wave-<n>/<date>.md (keep-history) via run-memory — counts and links only, read by the next run
